scraped.title: Multi-Purpose Household Survey (MPHS)
scraped.subtitle: Central Statistical Office of Afghanistan for Designing a Multi-Purpose Household Survey (MPHS) Questionnaire
scraped.clientName: Delegation of the European Union in Afghanistan
scraped.description: The project aimed to assess the information needs of key ministries and development partners in household statistics, map their planned statistical activities, and establish communication channels between the Central Statistical Office (CSO) and stakeholders. Additionally, it…
body: The project aimed to assess the information needs of key ministries and development partners in household statistics, map their planned statistical activities, and establish communication channels between the Central Statistical Office (CSO) and stakeholders. Additionally, it involved developing a draft questionnaire for the upcoming National Risk and Vulnerability Assessment (NRVA) surveys and facilitating agreement on the final version.
ICON-INSTITUT ensured with its activities the readiness for the Multi-Purpose Household Survey (MPHS), with the NRVA 2010 questionnaire aligned to the 2007/2008 version to ensure data comparability.
